interpretation.finding: The later 256- and 1024-device idle trials passed with complete observations and clean teardown on the same cached native-TLS executable. The earlier 256-device warmup failure remains evidence of setup reliability, not a demonstrated steady-state maximum.
interpretation.limit: This is an idle-connection test with resumed-delivery probes bounded to eight users, not 1024 simultaneously active writers. The earlier startup failure cause was not isolated.
